resources.name: Adaptation Uses
resources.description: Daily uses of Adaptation. Each talent gained consumes one use; Share Adaptation consumes two uses.

resources.name: Steady Skill — Take 15
resources.description: Expend martial focus to take 15 on the selected skill as though taking 10. At 19th level, Skill Juggler improves this to take 20.

notes: Sequence and Imbue remain specialized shared subsystems; Adaptation and Steady Skill use the generic class-resource contract.
